name: bm-unstar
description: C→S bm.unstar (protocol 1.6, D-11): remove EVERY bookmark whose URL exactly matches that tab's URL. Same integer `tabId` shape as bm.star, and explicitly NOT a toggle — an idempotent star/unstar pair cannot invert the wrong state when a snapshot lands between tap and delivery (D-12). Confirm-gated phone-side; fire-and-forget on the wire.
